# Pay per token

Prices are US dollars per **1 million tokens**, from each provider's own pricing page. Cached input is the price for a repeated prompt prefix, where the provider offers it. Rows are sorted by output price, cheapest first. Providers change prices often: check the source link before you rely on a number.

The privacy policy says inputs may be used for training; opt out by emailing privacy@deepseek.com. The OpenAI-compatible endpoint is the same host without /anthropic. Good worker value, but never for private code.

Gemini 3.8 Flash's price is a launch price until 31 Dec 2026, then $1.50 input, $0.15 cached, $7.50 output.

### OpenRouter (paid) {#openrouter-paid}

| | |
|---|---|
| Vendor | OpenRouter |
| Type | Pay per token |
| API | OpenAI-compatible · `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1` |
| Fees and credits | 5.5% fee on credit purchases (8% on Business). Bring your own provider key (BYOK): no fee up to $25k a month of list-price inference, 5% after. |
| Trains on prompts | 🟠 opt-out ([terms](https://openrouter.ai/docs/guides/privacy/data-collection)) |
| Pricing source | [https://openrouter.ai/pricing](https://openrouter.ai/pricing) |
| Verified | 2026-11-20 |

Model prices pass through from the upstream provider. data_collection defaults to "allow"; set it to "deny" and require zero data retention (zdr: true) in the request's provider settings to keep prompts out of training.
